answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 8291 Country: India Title: Whether taraveeh and qiamullael are one and the same or different? please clarify. Question: Whether taraveeh and qiamullael are one and the same or different? please clarify. Answer ID: 8291 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1772/1668=D/1429) The word qiyamullai is common, it includes tahujjud as well as taravih , but generally it is used for tahajjud, while taravih is called qiyam Ramzan i.e. if qiyam is attributed to Ramzan it means taravih . It is Sunnah to perform 20 rakah taravih in the whole month of Ramzan before going to bed. As well, the Prophet (peace be upon him) offered tahajjud regularly round the year, which is 10 rakah beside three rakah witr i.e. 13 rakah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
